name: cavemio-sortable-list
title: Sortable list
description: Drag to reorder and everything moves: rows slide out of the way, the dropped one settles, every rank rolls, and presets re-sort the lot.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each grip is a button named "Reorder …" with instructions attached; picking up, every move, dropping and cancelling are announced politely.
- Rows move with transforms while you drag and only change order on drop, so heavy row content doesn’t re-render on every pointer move.
- For long lists inside a scrolling box, keep the box tall enough to drag within; it doesn’t scroll itself while you drag.
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion rows move in place without gliding.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: items
props.description: – · The list in its current order.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: – · Called with the new order after a drop, a keyboard move or a preset. Update items with it; if you don’t, the rows glide back.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: – · A row’s content, between the rank and the edge; the grip, rank, border and motion are handled.

props.name: getLabel
props.description: – · The name used in the grip’s label and the announcements.

props.name: sorts
props.description: – · Presets shown as a segmented control; the one the order currently matches shows as pressed.

features.title: Lift and drag
features.description: Press a row’s grip and it lifts and follows your finger exactly, while the rows it passes slide one slot out of the way.

features.title: It settles, and says how far
features.description: The dropped row settles with a small overshoot and a “↑ 2” chip shows how far it moved before fading.

features.title: Ranks that roll
features.description: Every rank number rolls to its new place instead of changing at once.

features.title: Sort presets
features.description: Presets above the list re-sort everything at once and the rows glide. The highlight fades into “Your order” after a manual change.

features.title: Keyboard reordering
features.description: Space or Enter picks a row up, the arrows move it, Space drops it and Escape puts it back. Every move is announced.

features.title: Saves safely
features.description: onReorder gives you the new order. Save it, and put the old one back if the save fails.

states.title: lift
states.description: Pressing the grip: the row’s border darkens, it scales to 1.015 (200ms) and rises above the others. The grip takes the pointer, so touch scrolling elsewhere is untouched.

states.title: drag
states.description: The row follows the pointer without easing; rows it passes shift by one row height (220ms) the moment its centre crosses theirs.

states.title: drop
states.description: onReorder gets the new order; every row glides from where it was on screen (FLIP, 420ms) and the dropped one settles with a slight overshoot (380ms). Ranks roll; a "↑ 2" chip blurs in and out over 1.8s.

states.title: sort
states.description: A preset sorts the whole list with the same glide. The pressed preset is whichever the current order matches; with none, the highlight fades and "Your order" shows.

states.title: keyboard
states.description: Space or Enter on a grip picks the row up (aria-pressed), ↑ and ↓ move it a place at a time with the same glide, Space drops it, Escape puts it back where it started.
